findings.title: Exposed secret: Hard-coded credential
findings.detail: A credential-like string was found in source. If this is a real key it can be stolen from your repo/bundle and abused (billing fraud, data theft).
findings.fix: Move it to an environment variable / server-side only. Rotate the key now. Add the file to .gitignore. Never ship secrets in client JS.

findings.title: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML — sanitize input
findings.detail: Untrusted data reaching this sink can execute scripts in your users' browsers.
findings.fix: Sanitize/escape input, prefer textContent, or use a trusted templating layer.

findings.title: A form has 9+ fields
findings.detail: Every extra field cuts completion. Long forms are a top CVR killer for lead gen.
findings.fix: Cut to essentials (often just email/phone). Use multi-step for the rest.

findings.title: Heavy image 2222 KB (.png)
findings.detail: Large images are the #1 cause of slow LCP. Slow pages = lower conversion, higher CPC/CPA, worse ad Quality Score → lower ROAS.
findings.fix: Compress and convert to WebP/AVIF; serve responsive sizes with srcset. Target < 150 KB for hero, < 80 KB for supporting images.

findings.title: target="_blank" without rel="noopener"
findings.detail: Opened page can access window.opener and redirect your tab (tabnabbing).
findings.fix: Add rel="noopener noreferrer" to external target=_blank links.

findings.title: target="_blank" without rel="noopener"
findings.detail: Opened page can access window.opener and redirect your tab (tabnabbing).
findings.fix: Add rel="noopener noreferrer" to external target=_blank links.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy detected
findings.detail: A CSP is one of the strongest defenses against XSS and injected scripts.
findings.fix: Add a CSP via server header or <meta http-equiv> once you know your asset origins.

findings.title: Next.js Metadata API in use — verify per-route metadata
findings.detail: This file renders <head> but the project uses the metadata export API. Confirm each route/page defines its own title, description, canonical and OG image.
findings.fix: Ensure every page.tsx exports `metadata` (or generateMetadata) with unique values.

findings.title: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML — sanitize input
findings.detail: This is the standard Next.js pattern for injecting JSON-LD structured data from a trusted, server-built object — low risk.
findings.fix: Fine as-is if the object is server-built. Only escape < in the JSON string if any field can contain user input.

findings.title: package.json present — run a dependency audit
findings.detail: Offline scan can't check npm advisories, but outdated deps are a top vuln source.
findings.fix: Run `npm audit` and `npm outdated`; update majors carefully and re-test.
